items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter was playing the alto. Lorenzo Pack and Johnny Russell and Cozy Cole.

ctx.x: Yeah, they said it's too rich. So I said, let Lips play the sixth. We'll never give it to any of the others because they didn't want to hear it. But Benny says, I don't care what it sounds like, play what he writes. And that's when Morton Swing came in, too, while Benny was in the band. And --
Well, actually,when you listen to the old records by that band, that was a pretty poor band.
